title: A Bit of Kindness
lines: Rosa found a small pup in the yard.
It was wet and shaking in the cold rain.
Rosa took it in and got it dry.
They made a sign. It was helpful.
A thankful girl came. "That is my pup!"
She held out a reward. Rosa said no.
"Just come back to play," said Rosa.

questions.ask: Where did Rosa find the pup?
questions.listenFor: In the yard, in the cold rain. The first two lines both help.

questions.ask: What did Rosa say when the girl held out a reward?
questions.listenFor: She said no, and asked the girl to come back to play instead.

questions.ask: Would you have taken the reward? Why?
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer here. Listen for a reason that fits the story.
